body:
Proposal Number: CPI/2026/00538
Insured: Meenakshi Textile Mills Pvt. Ltd.
Broker: Coastal Line Insurance Brokers Pvt. Ltd.

Dear Coastal Line Insurance Brokers Pvt. Ltd.,

The submission for Meenakshi Textile Mills Pvt. Ltd. (Proposal CPI/2026/00538) cannot proceed to underwriting review until the following mandatory items are provided:
  - Annual Revenue
  - Deductible
  - Electrical Hazards
  - Fire Protection System
  - Flammable Materials
  - Hazardous Processes
  - Last Safety Inspection Date
  - Natural Catastrophe Cover
  - Primary Property Address
  - Registered Address
  - Requested Sum Insured
  - Risk Mitigation Measures

Required Action: Provide the missing fields and resubmit.

Regards,
Underwriting Team, Commercial Property Division
reason: Missing mandatory fields: Annual Revenue, Deductible, Electrical Hazards, Fire Protection System, Flammable Materials, Hazardous Processes, Last Safety Inspection Date, Natural Catastrophe Cover, Primary Property Address, Registered Address, Requested Sum Insured, Risk Mitigation Measures
